title: What Every Writer Wants
question: How do professional writers ignore what they were taught at school about writing?

meanings.usage: 指坦率承认自己的过错、秘密或真实想法，后可接that从句、to doing sth结构
强调变化、差异等程度极深，涉及事物的本质层面
指主张极端社会或政治变革的人
可表示调整设备参数、重新安排计划，也可指对文学作品内容进行大幅调整
指经过仔细观察、思考后识别出原本模糊或隐藏的事物

meanings.meaning: 难以形容的；无法描述的
meanings.usage: 用于修饰感受、景象等强烈到难以用语言表达的事物
不可数名词，可表示事物本身的吸引力，也可指人对某物的着迷状态，后常接介词for/with
可形容图像、边界等视觉上的模糊，也可指记忆、概念等抽象事物的不清晰
强调理解复杂、神秘的事物，常用于否定句或疑问句中

meanings.meaning: 英寻（测量水深单位，约合1.8米）

meanings.usage: 带有贬义，修饰持续时间过长、让人厌烦的动作
指言论、问题等与讨论的主题直接相关且有价值，后常接介词to
可指社会缺乏政府管控的混乱状态，也可形容抽象事物的无序状态
可形容人冷漠绝情，也可形容规则、标准等非常严苛没有转圜余地
用于修饰想法、感受、地点等处于最核心、最隐秘的位置

phrases.usage: 表示开始写作、动笔的固定表达，语体偏正式

examples.en: She had been planning the story for months before she finally set pen to paper.
examples.zh: 她为这个故事构思了好几个月，才终于动笔开始写。

phrases.usage: 表示“被当作；被误认为”，强调事物和实际标准有差距但被当成合格的或真实的

examples.en: In this small town, a simple meal of noodles and eggs passes for a luxury.
examples.zh: 在这个小镇里，一顿简单的鸡蛋面都被当成奢侈的食物。

phrases.usage: 插入语，意为“据我所知”，强调说话者对所说内容的真实性十分确定

examples.en: To my certain knowledge, he has never lied to anyone in the team.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他从来没有对团队里的任何人撒过谎。

phrases.usage: 表示“重新开始；从头再来”，强调抛开之前的积累或错误重头做起

examples.en: After the failure of his first business, he moved to another city to begin afresh.
examples.zh: 第一次创业失败后，他搬到了另一个城市从头开始。

phrases.usage: 表示“挖掘出；费尽周折找出”，指付出努力得到隐藏的信息或事物

examples.en: The journalist spent three months trying to winkle out the truth behind the scandal.
examples.zh: 这名记者花了三个月的时间，试图挖出这起丑闻背后的真相。

phrases.usage: 表示“倒不如；不妨”，用于建议做某事，或强调两种情况结果差不多、都没有意义

examples.en: Since the train is delayed for two hours, we might as well go to the café nearby to wait.
examples.zh: 既然火车晚点了两个小时，我们倒不如去附近的咖啡馆等着。

phrases.usage: 表示“抽出时间；暂时放下（手头的事）”，后可接from sth说明停下的事情

examples.en: He decided to take time off from work to spend more time with his sick mother.
examples.zh: 他决定暂时放下工作，花更多时间陪伴生病的母亲。

phrases.usage: 表示“在其最核心处；在最深处”，用于描述事物或情感的本质层面

examples.en: The poem touches the vulnerability at the inmost point of human nature.
examples.zh: 这首诗触及了人性最深处的脆弱。

sentences.en: I have known very few writers,
sentences.zh: 我认识的作家很少，

sentences.en: but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
sentences.zh: 但我所认识和尊重的那几位作家，都立刻承认他们在首次提笔写作时，对要写什么几乎没有什么概念。

sentences.en: They have a character, perhaps two;
sentences.zh: 他们可能有一个人物，或许两个；

sentences.en: they are in that condition of eager discomfort which passes for inspiration all admit radical changes of destination once the journey has begun;
sentences.zh: 他们处于那种急切不安的状态，那种状态被认为是灵感，一旦旅程开始，所有人都承认目的地会发生根本性变化；

sentences.en: one, to my certain knowledge, spent nine months on a novel about Kashmir,
sentences.zh: 据我所知，有一位作家花九个月写了一部关于克什米尔的小说，

sentences.en: then reset the whole thing in the Scottish Highlands.
sentences.zh: 然后将整个故事背景改到了苏格兰高地。

sentences.en: I never heard of anyone making a 'skeleton', as we were taught at school.
sentences.zh: 我从未听说有人像我们在学校里学的那样，先写好“提纲”。

sentences.en: In the breaking and remaking, in the timing interweaving, beginning afresh,
sentences.zh: 在打破与重塑、适时交织、重新开始的过程中，

sentences.en: the writer comes to discern things in his material which were not consciously in his mind when he began.
sentences.zh: 作家开始辨明他材料中那些在开始时并未意识到的东西。

sentences.en: This organic process, often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery, is of an indescribable fascination.
sentences.zh: 这种有机过程，常常带来非凡的自我发现时刻，具有难以言喻的魅力。

sentences.en: A blurred image appears; he adds a brushstroke and another and it is gone
sentences.zh: 一个模糊的图像出现了；他添上一笔又一笔，然后它消失了，

sentences.en: but something was there, and he will not rest till he has captured it.
sentences.zh: 但有些东西曾在那儿，他不会停歇直到捕捉到它。

sentences.en: Sometimes the yeast within a writer outlives a book he has written.
sentences.zh: 有时，作家内心的“酵母”比他写的一本书活得更久。

sentences.en: I have heard of writers who read nothing but their own books;
sentences.zh: 我听说过有些作家除了自己的书什么都不读；

sentences.en: like adolescents they stand before the mirror,
sentences.zh: 他们像青少年一样站在镜子前，

sentences.en: and still cannot fathom the exact outline of the vision before them.
sentences.zh: 却仍然无法完全理解眼前景象的精确轮廓。

sentences.en: For the same reason, writers talk interminably about their own books,
sentences.zh: 出于同样的原因，作家们滔滔不绝地谈论自己的书，

sentences.en: winkling out hidden meanings, super-imposing new ones,
sentences.zh: 挖掘隐藏的意义，叠加新的意义，

sentences.en: begging response from those around them.
sentences.zh: 乞求周围人的回应。

sentences.en: Of course a writer doing this is misunderstood: he might as well try to explain a crime or a love affair.
sentences.zh: 当然，这样做会使作家被误解：他倒不如去解释一起犯罪或一段恋情。

sentences.en: He is also, incidentally, an unforgivable bore.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他也是一个不可原谅的无聊之人。

sentences.en: This temptation to cover the distance between himself and the reader,
sentences.zh: 这种弥合自己与读者之间距离的诱惑，

sentences.en: to study his image in the sight of those who do not know him, can be his undoing: he has begun to write to please.
sentences.zh: 在不认识他的人眼中审视自己的形象，可能会导致他的失败：他已经开始为了取悦他人而写作。

sentences.en: A young English writer made the pertinent observation a year or two back
sentences.zh: 一两年前，一位年轻的英国作家发表了中肯的评论，

sentences.en: that the talent goes into the first draft, and the art into the drafts that follow.
sentences.zh: 才能体现在初稿中，而艺术则体现在后续的草稿中。

sentences.en: For this reason also the writer, like any other artist,
sentences.zh: 也正是因为这个原因，作家，像其他任何艺术家一样，

sentences.en: has no resting place, no crowd or movement in which he may take comfort,
sentences.zh: 没有安身之所，没有可以从中寻求慰藉的人群或运动，

sentences.en: no judgment from outside which can replace the judgment from within.
sentences.zh: 没有外部的评判能够取代其内在的评判。

sentences.en: A writer makes order out of the anarchy of his heart;
sentences.zh: 作家从内心无序的状态中创造出秩序；

sentences.en: he submits himself to a more ruthless discipline than any critic dreamed of,
sentences.zh: 他让自己服从于一种比任何评论家所梦想的都更无情的纪律，

sentences.en: and when he flirts with fame, he is taking time off from living with himself,
sentences.zh: 当他追逐名利时，他是在从与自我共处中抽身，

sentences.en: from the search for what his world contains at its inmost point.
sentences.zh: 从寻找他世界最深处包含的东西中抽身。

exercises.prompt: “混乱；无政府状态” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: anarchy · /ˈænəki/ · noun · 混乱；无政府状态。可指社会缺乏政府管控的混乱状态，也可形容抽象事物的无序状态

exercises.hint: 既然火车晚点了两个小时，我们倒不如去附近的咖啡馆等着。
exercises.explain: might as well：表示“倒不如；不妨”，用于建议做某事，或强调两种情况结果差不多、都没有意义（既然火车晚点了两个小时，我们倒不如去附近的咖啡馆等着。）

exercises.explain: He is also, incidentally, an unforgivable bore. — 顺便说一句，他也是一个不可原谅的无聊之人。

状语从句中的虚拟语气

grammar.title: 定语从句的连用
grammar.definition: 当先行词同时被多个定语从句修饰时，多个定语从句可以并列连接，共同限定先行词的范围
grammar.structure: 先行词 + 定语从句1 + and + 定语从句2
grammar.usage: 用于从多个角度描述同一个先行词，丰富先行词的信息

examples.en: but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
examples.zh: 但我所认识的、我所尊敬的那些作家，都立刻承认他们刚动笔的时候，根本不知道自己要写什么。

examples.en: The books that my father collected and which he kept for years were all donated to the village library.
examples.zh: 我父亲收集的、珍藏了很多年的那些书，全都捐给了乡村图书馆。

grammar.title: as引导的方式状语从句
grammar.definition: as引导方式状语从句时，意为“正如；按照”，用于说明主从句动作的方式一致
grammar.usage: 常用来引出人们已知的事实、常规做法等，和主句的内容形成对比或参照

examples.en: I never heard of anyone making a 'skeleton', as we were taught at school.
examples.zh: 我从来没听说过有人像我们在学校里被教的那样，先写个“提纲”。

examples.en: Please do the experiment as the teacher demonstrated in class.
examples.zh: 请按照老师课上演示的那样做这个实验。

grammar.title: which引导的非限制性定语从句
grammar.definition: 非限制性定语从句用来对先行词或者整个主句的内容进行补充说明，和主句之间用逗号隔开，去掉从句后主句意思依然完整
grammar.structure: 主句, which + 从句内容
grammar.usage: 用于补充额外信息，which可以指代前面的单个名词，也可以指代整个主句的内容

examples.en: This organic process, often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery, is of an indescribable fascination.
examples.zh: 这种有机的过程，常常会带来非同寻常的自我发现时刻，有着难以形容的魅力。

examples.en: She finally passed the driving test, which made her whole family very happy.
examples.zh: 她终于通过了驾照考试，这让她全家人都很高兴。

patterns.pattern: I have known very few + 名词, but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that + 从句

original.en: I have known very few writers, but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
original.zh: 我认识的作家很少，但我所认识的、我所尊敬的那些作家，都立刻承认他们刚动笔的时候，根本不知道自己要写什么。

examples.en: I have known very few traditional craftsmen, but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they spend at least three years mastering the basic skills.
examples.zh: 我认识的传统手艺人很少，但我所认识的、我所尊敬的那些手艺人，都立刻承认他们要花至少三年时间才能掌握基础技艺。

examples.en: I have known very few successful entrepreneurs, but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they have faced countless failures before achieving their goals.
examples.zh: 我认识的成功企业家很少，但我所认识的、我所尊敬的那些企业家，都立刻承认他们在达成目标前曾遭遇过无数次失败。

patterns.pattern: For the same reason, + 主句内容, doing sth, to do sth, begging response from sb

original.en: For the same reason, writers talk interminably about their own books, winkling out hidden meanings, super-imposing new ones, begging response from those around them.
original.zh: 出于同样的原因，作家们没完没了地谈论自己的书，挖掘其中隐藏的含义，叠加新的解读，渴望从身边的人那里得到回应。

examples.en: For the same reason, young designers talk excitedly about their new works, explaining their original ideas, adjusting details according to feedback, begging recognition from the audience.
examples.zh: 出于同样的原因，年轻的设计师们兴奋地谈论自己的新作品，解释他们的原创理念，根据反馈调整细节，渴望得到观众的认可。

examples.en: For the same reason, students share their creative projects in class, showing the process of exploration, pointing out the innovations of their work, begging advice from the teacher.
examples.zh: 出于同样的原因，学生们在课堂上分享自己的创意项目，展示探索的过程，指出作品的创新之处，渴望得到老师的建议。

patterns.pattern: A + 身份名词 + made the pertinent observation + 时间状语 that + 观察结论

original.en: A young English writer made the pertinent observation a year or two back that the talent goes into the first draft, and the art into the drafts that follow.
original.zh: 一两年前，一位年轻的英国作家给出了一个中肯的看法：才华体现在初稿里，而艺术则体现在后续的修改稿中。

examples.en: A senior education expert made the pertinent observation last year that the core of quality education is to cultivate children's ability to learn independently.
examples.zh: 去年，一位资深的教育专家给出了一个中肯的看法：素质教育的核心是培养孩子自主学习的能力。

examples.en: A famous environmental scientist made the pertinent observation a few months ago that reducing single-use plastic is more effective than recycling in controlling plastic pollution.
examples.zh: 几个月前，一位著名的环境科学家给出了一个中肯的看法：在治理塑料污染方面，减少一次性塑料的使用比回收更有效。
